metadata.description: Custom Claude Code plugins for design + development workflows.

plugins.name: dd-crawl
plugins.description: Whole-site URL inventory and broken-link check — robots-aware crawl, chrome-once tables, Framework dashboard with all-urls.csv / broken.csv / data.json.

plugins.name: dd-designmd
plugins.description: Extract a semantic design system from a website URL into {domain}-design.md, tokens, and a light Framework dashboard with download links.

plugins.name: dd-a11y
plugins.description: WCAG 2.2 accessibility audit — Playwright + axe-core, single or multi-page, light pin-map screenshots by default for large runs, generates client deliverables.

plugins.name: dd-blogs
plugins.description: ldnddev brand-tone copywriting skill — produces blog HTML markup, ld+json, SEO meta, and social posts.

plugins.name: dd-framework
plugins.description: ldnddev Framework component skill — guides AI agents to add and configure framework components correctly.

plugins.name: dd-seo
plugins.description: Deterministic LLM-first SEO audits for sites, blog posts, and GitHub repos — schema, AEO/GEO, prioritized fixes. Speed/CWV audits are dd-site-speed.

plugins.name: dd-vreg
plugins.description: Visual regression reporter — desktop/mobile screenshot diffing across two sites with Markdown + HTML reports.

plugins.name: dd-site-compare
plugins.description: Compare 2+ websites into a self-contained HTML + JSON dashboard — homepage competitive signals, primary-site marking, parallel fetching.

plugins.name: dd-pantheon
plugins.description: Update, deploy, and maintain WordPress + Drupal sites on Pantheon — terminus-driven, multidev-aware, Lando local-first, per-site registry.

plugins.name: dd-aws
plugins.description: Update, deploy, and maintain WordPress + Drupal sites on AWS (EC2/RDS/CloudFront) — access-aware per-site registry, Bitbucket Pipelines deploys, Lando local-first.

plugins.name: dd-site-speed
plugins.description: Page speed and Core Web Vitals audit — Google PageSpeed Insights (mobile + desktop), What/Why/How issue insights, stack-aware recommendations, branded dashboard + MD/DOCX/CSV task list.

plugins.name: dd-audit
plugins.description: Orchestrator for a primary-URL site audit — requires dd-crawl, dd-seo, dd-site-speed, and dd-site-compare installed; v1 runs crawl + SEO + speed into one nested cover dashboard.
